d: HYROX is taking the fitness world by storm, and it now has its sights set on an even bigger stage. The global fitness racing phenomenon has partnered with World Triathlon, bringing hybrid racing a step closer to its ambition of reaching the Olympic and Paralympic Games. HYROX CEO aims for the Brisbane Olympics 2032 and Paralympics. With its unique mix of running and functional fitness, HYROX is attracting thousands of participants across the world, including in India, where the sport is growing rapidly. Rupha Ramani examines the rise of HYROX and whether the gym could become an unlikely…
